scope: Whitelisted metadata and numeric audit results; no raw Session messages, model reasoning, shell commands, credentials or private filesystem paths. Fixed task definitions appear separately in inputs.json.

metricDefinitions.providerRetries: summary.json providerRetries counts observed Root retry events only; comprehensive worker retry events are unavailable.
metricDefinitions.tokens: Recorded input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite across actual owned Sessions; inherited parent history is not added a second time.
metricDefinitions.estimatedCostUSD: SDK estimate for recorded usage. Four cancelled workers may have unreported in-flight usage; actual provider billing is unavailable.
metricDefinitions.hostDurationMs: Recorded Host run interval; independent patch evaluation time is excluded.
metricDefinitions.initialThreeWorkersOverlapMs: Common overlap of all three first worker turn lifetimes from final records; this is not continuous CPU or model execution.
metricDefinitions.completed: Agent loop completed; independent patch acceptance is recorded separately.
metricDefinitions.toolResultErrors: Count of recorded isError tool results across the arm Sessions, including aborted wait_agent calls.
metricDefinitions.stageSourceSha256: Captured staged source, including runtime overlay/import metadata; distinct from candidate source and patch hash.
metricDefinitions.mailboxConsumed: Delivered into recipient Session; does not establish model comprehension or fault-recovery exactly-once guarantees.

coverageLimits: All six workers explicitly requested all; this covers copying one initial user task, not omission-default selection, numeric-window selection, filtered historical assistant/tool/thinking content, or compaction summaries.

Root configuration records expose tool names only; locked root spawn schema was independently constructed from the same Supervisor factory before startup. Worker records include actual complete schema.
Configuration and initial overlap compliance do not imply acceptance or complete provider billing.
DNS order ipv4first does not establish the actual network connection address family.

limitations: Four aborted worker records report zero tokens and zero cost. This cannot establish that cancelled provider work was free or fully reported.

Root Pi retry events are recorded. Worker IPC does not export the complete Pi retry-event stream; no worker provider error records were found, but a comprehensive worker/internal transport retry count is unavailable.
Mailbox consumption confirms entry into the recipient Session, not model understanding. This run cannot establish exactly-once delivery across failures.

All six workers forked one initial user task. This validates initial fork provenance and independent usage, not numeric fork windows, default omission, or filtering of complex historical assistant/tool/thinking content.
Observed completion of an agent loop or a clean stage integrity check does not establish acceptance of the bug fix.
No source edit overlapped a live Godot execution in this attempt, so the behavior of an old stage while candidate bytes change was not exercised.
Only Root edited source; concurrent independent or conflicting source writers were not exercised.
Recorded Host timestamps order requests and acknowledgements; mailbox consumption does not prove a causal contribution to the chosen edit.
This audit neither invokes Godot nor creates model requests.
